approach: Static recompilation of the game into native C, plus a runtime that reproduces the hardware, so no interpreter sits in the hot path.
help: Reverse engineering the room and object system
notes: Public builds for Linux x86_64 since v0.1, toolchain only: the user supplies their own copy of the game and no game data is distributed. Boot and gameplay match a cycle-accurate reference frame for frame on what was measured, and the runtime passes 75 of 75 Blargg and Mooneye hardware tests. In progress: a widescreen remaster that composes a 256px surface out of the guest's own framebuffer, revealing the room beyond the original 160 columns in outdoor areas. Windows and Android are planned, not built.
